chapters.title: Triangle's Business Central focus and reskill program overview
Benefits for senior team and junior development
Career growth and diversity in the community
Impact on hiring and community retention

features.name: BC Reskill Program
features.description: A training program that combines product training on Business Central with professional skills development and one-to-one coaching sessions. Covers certification knowledge, advanced topics like copilot and AI, warehouse functionality, and telemetry.

features.name: Product training for Business Central certification
features.description: Extensive training focused on knowledge needed for Business Central certification, with depth into advanced topics such as copilot and AI, advanced warehouse functionality, and telemetry.

features.name: Professional skills training
features.description: Soft skills training for consultants including presentation, communication, press activities, and negotiation skills to prepare them to work directly with customers.

features.name: One-to-one coaching sessions
features.description: Mentoring component of the reskill program where team members receive individual coaching to support their learning and professional development.

features.name: Reskill community
features.description: A community program that provides access to webinars, workshops, and training from Microsoft trainers. Facilitates peer connections and meaningful relationships among participants.
